factors.name: Shooting star at a top / hammer at a bottom left a weak leve
Price ran toward the level and stopped short, or broke it an
factors.call: (red[1] and (wk.lo_closes[1] == 0 or wk.lo_closes[1] >= 2)) or (wk.lo_broke[1] == 1 and wk.lo_back[1] >= 1)
factors.put: (green[1] and (wk.hi_closes[1] == 0 or wk.hi_closes[1] >= 2)) or (wk.hi_broke[1] == 1 and wk.hi_back[1] >= 1)

factors.name: Candle back the other way (or, after a break, the second can
factors.call: (green and wk.lo_back[1] == 0 and close > open[1]) or (wk.lo_back[1] >= 1 and green and close > close[1])
factors.put: (red and wk.hi_back[1] == 0 and close < open[1]) or (wk.hi_back[1] >= 1 and red and close < close[1])

heads_up.call: wk.lo_lvl > 0 and wk.lo_run >= 1 and ((red and ((wk.lo_closes == 0 and wk.lo_dist <= 1) or wk.lo_closes >= 2)) or (wk.lo_broke == 1 and wk.lo_back >= 1))
heads_up.put: wk.hi_lvl > 0 and wk.hi_run >= 1 and ((green and ((wk.hi_closes == 0 and wk.hi_dist <= 1) or wk.hi_closes >= 2)) or (wk.hi_broke == 1 and wk.hi_back >= 1))

text.call: A hammer formed a weak low at {wk.lo_lvl} ({wk.lo_run} candles ago). Price is {wk.lo_dist} ATR over it (negative = below it) and has closed below it {wk.lo_closes} time(s) in a row. If a green candle now closes above the previous candle's open (or, once it has broken the level, a second green candle in a row closes higher), the CALL signal follows.
text.put: A shooting star formed a weak high at {wk.hi_lvl} ({wk.hi_run} candles ago). Price is {wk.hi_dist} ATR under it (negative = above it) and has closed above it {wk.hi_closes} time(s) in a row. If a red candle now closes below the previous candle's open (or, once it has broken the level, a second red candle in a row closes lower), the PUT signal follows.

heads_up.title: weak level ahead
